overclaims: Modest street turnout and continued growth in global daily use limit stronger interpretations but do not negate a consumer boycott.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, criteria, axis, horizon and outcome all match. The rationale says 'continued growth in global daily use', but e3 shows only one day's 3% rise in ChatGPT's global mobile-app daily users, on March 2. That is neither a sustained trend nor total usage. Minor point: e3's explanation says the publication day is inferred from Sensor Tower calling March 2 'yesterday', but the visible text doesn't say that ('already up 8% DoD on March 3' points to March 3).
